Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Edit image 1, the selected Cold Steel hexagonal Rifle Mastery skill badge. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative composition/material/style reference. Image 2 is a PROJECT M4 CARBINE reference; use its rifle silhouette and component proportions only, not its low resolution, dark exposure, orange accent or background. Output exactly one polished square icon.
REQUIRED EDIT 1: completely REMOVE the central targeting reticle from image 1: every circular arc and all four crosshair ticks behind the rifle must disappear. Reconstruct a seamless, plain, dark graphite smoked-glass recessed badge face where they were. No crosshair, no target ring, no aiming marks, no residual lines or ghosting anywhere on the badge.
REQUIRED EDIT 2: replace the existing inaccurate sniper/bolt-action style rifle with a convincing high-quality M4 / AR-platform assault carbine, informed by image 2. Show a compact flat-top upper/lower receiver, recognizable M4 receiver geometry and ejection-port detail, realistic trigger guard and angled pistol grip, gently curved 30-round STANAG magazine seated cleanly in the magazine well, collapsible polymer shoulder stock on its buffer tube, straight aligned barrel, proportionate muzzle flash hider, and a precision-machined ventilated tactical handguard with continuous top Picatinny rail. Small folded mechanical sights, NO large telescopic sniper scope, NO bolt-action handle, no bipod. The components must be visually coherent, not melted or hybrid gun anatomy. This is a decorative game UI illustration, not an engineering diagram. Use readable physically convincing proportions and differentiated materials, with the carbine oriented stock lower-left and muzzle upper-right, matching the chosen badge's composition. Show the entire gun with generous clearance from all hexagon edges. Its raised dimensional body occupies around 75% of canvas width and is clearly the main focus.
PRESERVE from image 1: the exact six-sided badge silhouette, size/placement, all six corners, thin bevelled brushed-silver perimeter, inset smoked-glass background, nearly black square outer canvas, restrained top-left soft lighting, subtle dimensional shadows and premium industrial 3D icon style. Upgrade rifle rendering quality: realistic graphite anodized receiver and barrel, matte dark polymer stock/grip, crisp restrained silver edges and subtle brushed metal highlights. Keep the silver bright enough for small-icon readability without making the entire weapon chrome. Neutral black/gray/silver only. No blue, gold, orange or saturated highlights, no magical effects, no smoke, no particles, no muzzle firing, no text/letters/numerals/logos/watermark. Do not add alternative badges or any UI panels. One single finished revision of the chosen icon.
